Questions owners ask

How does the pricing work?

$799 a month covers all three services: your website, review automation and Google Business Profile management. There's a one-off $1,599 setup fee, which we waive if you pay quarterly or longer.

Do I own the website?

Yes. Your monthly payments pay the website off over 24 months, and then it's yours outright while the service keeps running.

What happens if I cancel?

There's no fee or penalty. Review automation stops, your Google profile goes back to you with every improvement in place, and the website switches off unless you buy it out.

I already use your review automation. Can I upgrade?

Yes, and nothing resets. Your review history, automations and integrations carry straight over.

I serve a lot of suburbs. Is 20 pages enough?

Twenty pages suits most businesses to start. We can build a larger site from day one, or add two new SEO pages a month with Site Booster.

How fast will I see results?

Your website draft is ready within 7 days and review requests start in the first week. Rankings usually start to move around months three to four, as reviews and profile activity add up.
